# OrcaSlicer printer artwork subset

This directory contains the machine-profile JSON files and matching printer cover images retained from the OrcaSlicer profile library. LayerVault uses them only to populate printer specifications and artwork; it does not include or execute the OrcaSlicer application.

Upstream project: https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer

The files are licensed under GNU AGPL-3.0. See `LICENSE.txt` in this directory. The snapshot was taken from the supplied OrcaSlicer 2.5 development source on 31 August 2026.
